claims.claim: OpenAI expanded its GPT-6 model tier by announcing GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, purpose-built for low-latency agentic computer and browser execution.
claims.notes: Official OpenAI product launch expanding the GPT-6 architecture family.

claims.claim: GPT-6 Sol delivers 4x faster token throughput and a 65% cost reduction compared to GPT-6 Astra for repetitive desktop workflow automation.
claims.notes: Verified against official OpenAI benchmark report.

claims.claim: GPT-6 Luna is an on-device quantized model running locally on desktop NPUs for instant UI perception without transmitting screenshots to cloud servers.
claims.notes: Ensures local data sovereignty and ultra-low UI latency.

editorial_cautions: Highlight the distinct roles of Sol (cloud high-speed agent) vs Luna (on-device local UI agent).
Emphasize the practical reduction in cost and latency for autonomous computer use.
